lines.text: I'm tight on cash this month.

data.define: Used when you have little money to spend right now.

example.text: I'm tight on cash this month.

misuse.text: Don't say 'tight on cash' about a tight shirt.

publish.title: What does "tight on cash" mean?
publish.value: Tight on cash = I don't have much money. Example: "I'm tight on cash this month." (casual English).
